objective: Proof: the growth reads the knot graph only through each knot's set of live neighbours and each live knot's open count, so the identification theorems hold for any multiplicity, given (S3), (S4) read on live knots and at least two loose distinctions; a start with one loose distinction closes at round 1. Machine check on the whole touch census.
status: Proved 2026-11-19 (referee pending): the growth reads a start only through each knot's live neighbours and each live knot's open count, so the identification and dimension theorems hold for knot multigraphs under (S3), (S4) on live knots and at least two loose distinctions; a one-loose start closes at round 1; on the touch census 11,512 of 11,512 arrangements in the class agree round by round.
title: The identification for knot graphs with multiple touches
